sn38.8:1.8: “But, reverend, what path and what practice, for giving up these three defilements?”
sn38.8:1.9: “Reverend, it is simply this noble eightfold path for giving up these three defilements, that is—
sn38.8:1.11: Reverend, this is the path, this is the practice, for giving up these three defilements.”
sn38.8:1.12: “Reverend, this is a fine path, a fine practice, for giving up these three defilements.
sn38.8:1.13: And just this much is enough for diligence, Reverend Sāriputta.”
